youtube.title: Octopus Ke 3 Dil Kyun Hote Hain? 🐙 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Octopus ke teen dil hote hain, aur tairte waqt inmein se ek ruk jaata hai.

Do chhote dil galphadon tak khoon bhejte hain, teesra poore shareer mein. Iska khoon neela hota hai, kyunki yeh oxygen ko taambe se dhota hai, lohe se nahin.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
